screen1.title: What is a pool?
screen1.body: Each cycle, the system places you in one pool. Your contribution reaches one nominee family and helps them.
screen1.progress_a11y: Screen one: what is a pool
screen2.title: Your pool's letter code
screen2.body: Every pool has a letter code — for example, “Pool A”. This code is always there.
screen2.body2: A pool may also be given a chosen name later, but the letter code always stays the same. A permanent identifier is kept for the record too.
screen2.progress_a11y: Screen two: your pool's letter code
screen3.title: If you help a family directly
screen3.body: Sometimes you hear of a colleague's passing yourself and help the family directly. That is your own act of support, and the trust holds it in respect. It stays between you and that family; the trust keeps no record of it. Your assigned pool's contribution for this cycle still stands separately.
screen3.body2: Separately: if a payment reaches a different pool than the one you were assigned, the helpdesk works with you to sort it out — your pool assignment stays as it is.
screen3.progress_a11y: Screen three: if you help a family directly
